tool_access.limitation: Driver shaft envelopes: near ear screws require 10 degree tilt; straight access fails. Physical engagement of tilted PH0 driver unverified. Install plate/spline retaining screw before pinion; finger bosses seat before cap. Physical tool handles, resin fits and real cable bend unverified.

clearances.description: Teeth entirely above band; only smaller finger roots and 3 mm pivot posts enter band; short hex bosses couple overhead gears. No long transmission shafts.

fidelity.region: Exported Z > 40 mm, beyond the retired handle hooks
Exported Z > 40 mm, beyond the retired handle hooks

lattice.process: Fine resin prototype allowance; not ordinary FDM or a strength rating.

overall_envelope.method: Analytic continuous X/Z vertex extrema, fixed Y; includes real servo, screw probes and cable clearance.

gear_phase_control.description: A 4 degree phase error intersects the right gear; correct full motion has no penetrating tooth volume.

fasteners.plate: 3 × M2×4, reuses 2 mm disk threaded thickness; actual thread depth unmeasured

motion_collisions.limitation: Sampled 0–30 degree stroke, not continuous collision proof. Probes omit intentional spline/thread engagement; center probe covers only exposed retaining head. No pair exclusions. Volume tolerance 0.0001 mm^3 covers STL face rounding at seated planes.
